pageSubtitle: A variety of projects I have worked on.

textile-pro.title: Textile Facility Admin Dashboard
textile-pro.description: Full-stack admin dashboard for textile production management with worker tracking, product oversight, and AI insights built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
textile-pro.longDescription:
• Developed a full-stack admin dashboard to streamline textile production management, including worker tracking, product oversight, production line monitoring, and AI insights.

• Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, featuring advanced tables (TanStack), dynamic forms (React Hook Form + Zod), and global state with Zustand.

• Enhanced user experience with shadcn/ui components and real-time data fetching via SWR/Axios.

• Designed and integrated a secure Express/Prisma backend with authentication and role-based access control.

erp-project.title: Enhancing an ERP Project
erp-project.description: Internship project featuring admin dashboard, internship management system with Google Meet scheduling, WebSocket real-time notifications, and employee training module.
erp-project.longDescription:
During my internship (iWare, Sousse):
• Built admin dashboard with React, Spring Boot and JWT for managing user roles and access control

• Created internship management system with Google Meet scheduling for interviews

• Set up WebSocket system for push and in-app notifications and real time messaging with MongoDB for storage

• Developed training module to help manage employee professional development

recipe-app.title: Recipe sharing application
recipe-app.description: Full-stack recipe platform with secure JWT authentication, image handling pipeline using GridFS and Sharp.js, and comprehensive REST API with MongoDB.
recipe-app.longDescription:
• Developed full-stack recipe platform with Node.js/Express, implementing JWT authentication and role-based access for admin/user/guest accounts

• Built secure image handling pipeline using GridFS, Multer and Sharp.js for processing, with MongoDB/Mongoose schemas for optimized data relationships

• Developed REST API for Recipe, Reviews, Users and Profiles with middleware authorization, comprehensive error handling, and EJS server-side rendering.

portfolio-v1.title: Portfolio v1
portfolio-v1.description: Responsive portfolio built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React featuring smooth Framer Motion animations and integrated EmailJS contact form.
portfolio-v1.longDescription:
• Built Portfolio v1 using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React for a responsive, modern interface.

• Enhanced with Framer Motion to create smooth animations and dynamic transitions.

• Form validation and state handling powered by React Hook Form for efficiency and performance.

• Integrated EmailJS for seamless contact form functionality.

portfolio-v2.title: Portfolio V2
portfolio-v2.description: Modern, full-featured portfolio website built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and featuring internationalization support, dark mode, and fully responsive design.
portfolio-v2.longDescription:
• Built Portfolio V2 using Next.js 16 with App Router and TypeScript for type-safe, modern web development.

• Implemented internationalization (i18n) support for English and French with language-based routing.

• Created dark/light theme switching with fully responsive design using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.

• Developed organized sections (Home, Experience, Projects, Stack, Contact) with smooth carousel component for project showcase.

• Structured with modular architecture including utilities, and static data management for easy customization.
